explainTr: Sonek (suffix) kelimenin sonuna eklenir ve çoğu zaman kelimenin türünü değiştirir. '-tion' ve '-ment' fiilden isim yapar: celebrate → celebration, improve → improvement, achieve → achievement.
'-ful' ('dolu, sahip') ve '-less' ('olmayan, -siz') isimden sıfat yapar: care → careful / careless, help → helpful / helpless. '-ly' sıfattan zarf yapar: careful → carefully, slow → slowly.

Yazımda dikkat: 'e' ile biten fiillerde -tion için 'e' düşer (celebrate → celebration), -ly öncesi 'y' 'i' olur (easy → easily). Cümlede boşluğa hangi türün geleceğine bak: isim mi, sıfat mı, zarf mı?
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'bakım-lı, bakım-sız' ekleri -ful ve -less gibi çalışır (careful / careless). Ama Türkçedeki 'yavaş-ça' İngilizcede 'slowly' olur ve fiilin yanında, yani zarf olarak kullanılır.

reading.title: Maple Grove Elementary newsletter
reading.text:
MAPLE GROVE ELEMENTARY NEWSLETTER - May Edition

A Message from the Principal

Dear families, this has been a year of real achievement. Our enrollment has grown by twelve percent, and test scores in reading show a steady improvement. We are grateful to every parent, teacher, and volunteer who made this progress possible. Your participation, whether at a meeting or in the hallway, truly matters.

Spring Celebration

Please join us on Friday, May 17, for our annual Spring Celebration on the playground. There will be games, music, and a bake sale. Students will perform songs they have practiced all month. Families are welcome to bring a blanket and enjoy the afternoon. If it rains, the event will move to the gym, so please check your email that morning.

Thank You, Donors

Last month's book drive was extremely successful. Because of your donations, the library received over four hundred new books. One generous family also donated a set of colorful beanbag chairs. The librarian said gratefully, "The children eagerly asked for the new stories on the very first day."

Volunteer Spotlight

This month we would like to thank Ms. Hafsa Yilmaz, who has helped in Mrs. Carter's second-grade class every Tuesday. She reads with small groups and patiently explains new words. "She is always cheerful and helpful," says Mrs. Carter. "The students warmly welcomed her from the first day, and their reading has gradually become stronger." Volunteers like Ms. Yilmaz are priceless, and we are always looking for more help.

Safety Reminder

Please remind your children to walk carefully in the hallways, especially after rain. Careless running leads to many small accidents. Our nurse also asks families to send a note when a child misses school for illness.

Important Dates

May 17: Spring Celebration. May 24: Early dismissal at noon. May 27: No school (Memorial Day). June 7: Last day of school.

writing.promptTr: Okul bülteni için 'Gönüllüye teşekkür' veya 'Okuma günü' hakkında kısa bir yazı hazırla (120-180 kelime). En az dört sonekli kelime kullan (-tion, -ment, -ful, -less, -ly).
writing.promptEn: Write a short article (120-180 words) for a school newsletter about a recent school event or a thank-you to volunteers. Use at least four words with the suffixes -tion, -ment, -ful, -less or -ly.
frames: The event was very successful because ...
writing.model: Last Friday, our school held its annual Reading Celebration, and it was a great success. Students came to school in costumes of their favorite book characters, and the hallways were full of color and laughter. We are especially grateful to the parent volunteers who read stories to the youngest children. Their patient and cheerful help was priceless. Thanks to your generous donations, the library received more than two hundred new books. The children eagerly chose their favorites during the afternoon book fair. We have also noticed a clear improvement in reading scores since the start of the year, which shows how important family participation is. Please remember to read with your child for fifteen minutes every evening. Our next event will be held in June, and we warmly invite everyone to join us. Thank you for your continued support of our school.
checklistTr: En az dört sonekli kelime kullandın mı (celebration, grateful, carefully, improvement...)?
Sonekleri doğru türde kullandın mı (isim, sıfat, zarf)?
Bülten gibi sıcak ve kısa cümlelerle mi yazdın?
Başlık, tarih ya da davet cümlesi ekledin mi?
